subject: SIG: audit feed export & delivery plan for Odexa
messages:
From: Kara Simmons <kara.simmons@odexa.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: ComplianceOps <soc2-audit@veritascompliance.io>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Audit feed for upcoming SIG assessment

Hi Rishi / Laura,

We're preparing for a SIG assessment scheduled for early April and need a copy of the admin/activity audit records for Odexa's org on Redwood. Specifically:
- The canonical list of event types you log (admin actions, API usage, key rotations, model deploys, etc.)
- A sample export covering Jan 01 2027 - Feb 28 2027 to validate fields and hashing/redaction approach
- Your standard retention policy and what options are available for 1+ year historic access
- Delivery mechanisms you support (S3 transfer, secure FTP, signed manifest, streaming webhook) and expected timelines
- Chain-of-custody / integrity guarantees (checksums, signatures)

We've attached a SIG scoping note (sig_request_0327.pdf). Can you confirm whether you can provide a dry-run sample and the export format? Also let us know if you need a preferred delivery bucket or credentials.

Thanks,
Kara Simmons
Senior IT Risk Manager
Odexa Health
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Kara Simmons <kara.simmons@odexa.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Audit feed for upcoming SIG assessment

Kara — thanks for the clear scope. We can produce the export you described. High-level options we can offer:

1) Full JSONL export (one event per line) compressed with gzip, with a signed manifest (SHA256 per object + overall manifest SHA256), delivered by either:
   - direct S3 upload to a customer bucket (we support cross-account role assumption)
   - pre-signed objects for your ingestion pipeline

2) Incremental streaming via our audit-feed API (sequence tokens + checkpointing) for downstream pipelines that prefer near real-time ingestion.

3) Bulk CSV snapshots (columnar) for quick inspection / tooling like Excel, plus a JSON schema sample.

Retention: Hosted default is 365 days for admin/event ledger; enterprise retention up to 7 years by contract. If you need 1 year of historic data (Jan-Feb 2027) we can export it immediately.

PII handling: we can either redact fields or apply salted hashing (customer-specific salt stored in KMS) — we usually provide the hashed identifier plus an indicator in the manifest.

Next step: please confirm your preferred delivery method (S3 role vs. presigned vs. secure FTP) and whether you require a KMS-encrypted payload or a signed PKCS7/GPG signature on the manifest. Once confirmed, we'll queue a dry-run sample.

I'll cc our infra lead to coordinate the actual export.

—Rishi
Director, Customer Security Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Kara Simmons <kara.simmons@odexa.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: ComplianceOps <soc2-audit@veritascompliance.io>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Audit feed for upcoming SIG assessment

Thanks Rishi — S3 upload is our preference. We can provide an ARN for cross-account role if that's easiest.
Couple of clarifications:
- Scope is both control-plane (admin actions) and data-plane access events for the timeframe Jan 01 2027 - Feb 28 2027.
- We need a manifest that includes: file list, SHA256 checksums, event range timestamps, and start/end sequence tokens for streaming reconciliation.
- Please include hashing of any PII (email addresses, user ids) rather than redaction if possible.

If you can provide a small sample (first 48 hours of Jan) in JSONL so the auditor can confirm fields, that will speed things up.

Kara
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Odexa SIG export — tasks & owners

Team — Kara confirmed S3 cross-account role + wants JSONL sample + PII hashing. Timeline: dry-run sample within 48 hours, full Jan-Feb export within 5 business days after approval. Please act as follows: 

- Laura: coordinate the cross-account role and confirm the S3 path/ARN with Odexa.
- Mina: prepare the export package (JSONL incremental + full bulk snapshot) and ensure we include these event classes (at minimum):
     admin.login, admin.logout, api.key.create, api.key.revoke, kms.key.rotate, model.deploy, model.rollback, model.serve.request, model.serve.error, permission.grant, permission.revoke, user.create, user.delete, infra.node.add, infra.node.remove, billing.invoice.generate, audit.config.change
  Include the sequence token range for each file.
- Aditya: ensure payloads are KMS-encrypted and sign the manifest with our signing key; include SHA256 checksums and manifest signature.
- Stephanie: add documentation for the auditor describing how to validate sequence tokens and re-ingest JSONL via our audit-feed client (include sample CLI).

Also note: customer requests salted hashing for PII. Mina — use the customer salt workflow (customer-specified salt wrapped by our KMS). If there are obstacles to deliver within the timeline, call it out immediately.

Thanks — Rishi
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Odexa SIG export — tasks & owners

WIP status and delivery plan:

1) Events & schema — confirmed. We'll include an events.schema.json (sample attached upon delivery) and provide field-level descriptions. Top-level event fields: timestamp (RFC3339), event_type, actor_id (hashed), actor_role, target_id (hashed if PII), resource_type, region, severity, request_path, user_agent, request_id, sequence_token.

2) Export approach:
   - Dry-run: JSONL for Jan 01 00:00 - Jan 02 23:59 as a single gzip (events_20270101-02.jsonl.gz) + sample CSV derived from same window for auditor convenience.
   - Full export: split into daily gzipped JSONL files with monotonically increasing sequence_token ranges; monthly full snapshot (monthly_202701.csv.gz) for easy tabular checks.

3) Delivery & integrity:
   - We'll upload to customer S3 path via cross-account role. Each object will have a corresponding SHA256 entry in export_manifest_20270318.sha256. The manifest will include: object_name, byte_size, sha256_hex, event_count, first_ts, last_ts, start_token, end_token.
   - Manifest will be signed with Redwood's signing key; we will also envelope the manifest with KMS (customer-provided or our shared export key). We can provide PKCS7 signature or an AWS KMS-signed attestation blob.

4) PII handling:
   - We will apply salted SHA256 hashing to actor_id / target_id fields. The salt will be unique per-customer and wrapped by our KMS. The auditor will receive the hashing scheme metadata but not the salt (unless Odexa requests key escrow for re-identification).

5) Validation & replay:
   - For streaming clients, sequence_token checkpoints are monotonic. We will include a small Python snippet in audit_export_instructions.md to replay JSONL using our audit-feed client and verify manifest checksums.

6) Timeline:
   - Dry-run sample ready by 2027-03-12 14:00 PST (we will upload sample_snapshot_20270311.csv and events_20270101-02.jsonl.gz).
   - Full Jan-Feb export targeted for 2027-03-18 by EOD, with manifest and signatures.

I'll attach the sample CSV and the instruction draft to the delivery email. Let me know if you want additional fields.

- Mina
Senior Platform Reliability Engineer
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Kara Simmons <kara.simmons@odexa.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>, ComplianceOps <soc2-audit@veritascompliance.io>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Delivery plan: Odexa audit export (Jan-Feb 2027)

Kara — quick status and delivery plan. Per Mina's work and your preference for S3 cross-account: 

What you'll get:
- Dry-run sample (uploaded): events_20270101-02.jsonl.gz, sample_snapshot_20270311.csv, events.schema.json
- Full export (pending approval): daily gzipped JSONL files for Jan 01 2027 - Feb 28 2027, plus monthly consolidated CSVs.
- Export manifest: export_manifest_20270318.sha256 (contains file list, byte sizes, sha256 checksums, event counts, first_ts/last_ts, start_token/end_token).
- Integrity & signing: manifest signed with Redwood signing key; manifest signature and KMS envelope uploaded alongside objects.
- PII: actor_id and target_id fields are salted-hashed (SHA256) per Odexa salt; hashing metadata included in events.schema.json.

Access & validation steps:
1) Provide cross-account role ARN and target prefix (s3://odexa-ingest/audit/2027/).
2) We will assume role and upload objects to that prefix. S3 object metadata will include sequence_token headers.
3) Use the provided export_manifest_20270318.sha256 to verify file integrity (we'll provide the CLI commands in audit_export_instructions.md).

Attached to this thread: sample_snapshot_20270311.csv, export_manifest_20270318.sha256, audit_export_instructions.md.

If that works, please confirm the ARN and whether you prefer a PKCS7 or KMS-attested manifest signature. Once you confirm we'll schedule the full export for 2027-03-18 and notify you when upload completes.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out quickly.

Best,
Rishi
(attachments referenced above are small metadata stubs: sig_request_0327.pdf (external request), sample_snapshot_20270311.csv (csv export sample), export_manifest_20270318.sha256 (manifest checksums + signed digest stub), audit_export_instructions.md (CLI + validation steps))
